text:
[Council File 26-1415; CD 4]
Categorical Exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15303, and Class 3 (New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures), and related CEQA findings; report from the Central Los Angeles Area Planning Commission (CLAAPC); and an appeal filed by Catherine J. Ripp, from the determination of the CLAAPC in approving a Categorical Exemption as the environmental clearance for the installation of a new unmanned wireless telecommunications facility on the rooftop of an existing 54-foot tall, five-story apartment building, the Project includes the installation of new Fiber-Reinforced Polymer (FRP) screen walls, nine panel antennas, 14 remote radio units, one surge suppressor, one power plant cabinet, one data cabinet, one battery cabinet, one TELCO box, and one electrical panel on the rooftop, the Project also includes the installation of a new generator connector, and an MTS disconnect switch at grade level, as well as a meter bank on the P3 level, the new FRP screen walls will be eight feet eight inches in height and will not extend above the existing 54-foot-tall apartment building; for the property located 2069 North Argyle Avenue (6261 West Holly Mount Drive).
Applicant: Gary Bodenwieser, AT&T Mobility
Representative: Jerry Ambrose, Eukon Group
Case No. ZA-2024-6024-CUW
Related Case Nos.: ZA-2024-6024-CUW-1A; ENV-2024-6025-CE
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
